---
# agnosticv_resolve: locate the ordered catalog item in the agnosticv checkout
- name: Report the requested catalog item
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "Resolving {{ agnosticv_item }} (stage {{ agnosticv_stage }}) from {{ agnosticv_repo }}@{{ agnosticv_ref }}"

- name: Check that the catalog item directory exists
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ agnosticv_checkout }}/{{ agnosticv_item }}"
  register: r_item_dir

- name: Stop when the catalog item is missing
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that: r_item_dir.stat.exists
    fail_msg: "Catalog item directory {{ agnosticv_item }} not found in {{ agnosticv_repo }}@{{ agnosticv_ref }}"

---
# retrieval-lab: retrieval-augmented generation lab on OpenShift AI
cloud_provider: ec2
env_type: ocp4-cluster

__meta__:
  catalog:
    display_name: Retrieval Lab
    category: Labs
  deployer:
    scm_url: https://github.com/agnosticd/agnosticd-v2.git
    scm_ref: main

retrieval_lab_vector_store: pgvector
retrieval_lab_model: granite-3-8b-instruct
